query:
SELECT t.tabular_id as dataset_id
        FROM tabular t
        INNER JOIN warehouse w ON w.warehouse_id = t.warehouse_id AND w.status = 'active'
        WHERE t.warehouse_id = $1
          AND t.namespace_id = $2
          AND t.name = $3
          AND t.typ = 'dataset'
          AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
